scope.source: Configured production src files only; native package dependents reported separately

policy: Analysis only. The sole allowed new file is impact-answer.json.
Every existing source, dependency, configuration and test file remains unchanged.
Exact direct symbol uses, conservative installed package dependents and native script targets are independently graded with evidence and precision/recall.
Source and built target declarations are identical for all arms. Setup costs remain separate.
Project scoped reference results do not establish repository wide absence; native multi-project activation and package filters remain allowed.
Development task only. No held-out performance claim follows from this case.
V2 grading is prospective. Original trial grades and source fixtures are unchanged.
Only constrained uncertainty states are accepted; unsupported certainty cannot be added as unchecked answer prose.
